summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration_21 bundle (NoteModal light-mode contrast fix + per-kid PIN on Kid Mode + weeklyChoreSummary wiring). All three new features verified end-to-end in a real browser session. 8/8 light-mode style assertions pass on NoteModal (pencil-edit / new-note modal), 3/3 dark-mode regression assertions pass. Daily Chores tile pack applies cleanly (12 kid notes in PARENT category). Full PIN flow works: set → persistence across close/reopen → wrong-PIN dot clearing → correct-PIN entry → 5-attempt lockout (keys disabled at opacity 0.4) → remove → drill-through. No weeklyChoreSummary runtime errors. Skipped explicit DnD reproduction since the fix was already verified in a prior iteration and the current bundle does not touch dragging code — but no drag/drop console errors appeared while operating on the 12-card PARENT category.

ui_bugs.issue: Nested <button> inside <button>: each kid card is a <button>, and the kid-pin-toggle inside it is also a <button>. React logs 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>. This will cause a hydration error.' Functionally works (e.stopPropagation prevents card click), but violates HTML spec and pollutes the console. Recommend rendering the outer card as a <div role='button' tabIndex={0}> or the inner toggle as a <span role='button'>.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Refactor KidPicker to avoid nested <button> in <button> (hydration warning in console — non-blocking, but a real HTML spec violation).
critical_code_review_comments: NoteModal.jsx (lines 181, 216, 222, 227): light-mode classes added exactly as specified. Verified computed color rgb(17, 24, 39) = text-gray-900 and caretColor rgb(79, 70, 229) = caret-indigo-600. Textarea also gets selection:bg-indigo-100 + selection:text-gray-900 as intended. Category & Subcategory inputs (222, 227) received text-gray-900 + placeholder:text-gray-400 but NOT caret-indigo-600 or selection classes — likely intentional (short inputs) but slightly inconsistent with title Input.

KidDashboardModal.jsx: KidPinGate submits after slice(0,4) on 4th digit with a 100ms setTimeout — works, but there's a subtle race: if a user hammers keys the setTimeout could enqueue multiple submits. Consider guarding submit() with a ref while pending. Not observed in normal use.
KidPinGate resets `entered` on wrong PIN but never resets on unmount — fine because component unmounts on cancel/success. OK.
KidDashboardModal has a nested <button> in <button> issue in KidPicker (see ui_bugs).

weeklyChoreSummary.js: requestPermission is called on every eligible load — consider gating behind a settings flag/user opt-in so we don't repeatedly prompt for the browser notification permission on Sunday evenings if the user has already denied it. Currently silently no-ops when denied, which is fine, but re-prompting UX may be jarring.
weeklyChoreSummary.js correctly returns early on non-Sunday / <18:00, so no runtime errors observed.

weekly_chore_summary_console.note: Today is not Sunday >= 18:00 local so function returns immediately as documented — no errors, wiring intact.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on required assertions; 1 minor HTML nesting warning noted separately

seed_data_creation: Applied 'chores-list' tile pack — created 12 kid notes named 'Chores list for <Name>' each with 12 seeded chores, category='PARENT'. Set kid_pin='1234' on the first kid, then removed it at end of test. Data lives in IndexedDB (offline PWA).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration bundled 3 pieces on top of iterations 19+20. NoteModal opens via fab-add-note (bottom-right) or per-note pencil (data-testid on tiles differs — use fab for quickest smoke test). Theme is React state (isDark), not html.dark class — toggle via header button whose svg is lucide-sun (in dark) or lucide-moon (in light). Tile pack testid = 'apply-pack-chores-list' (opens 12 chore notes). Kid Mode = 'header-kid-mode'. Kid PIN gate uses a 4-key keypad ('kid-pin-key-<digit>'); after 4 digits it auto-submits with a 100ms setTimeout. 5 wrong attempts → 30s lockout, keys disabled. WeeklyChoreSummary is a fire-and-forget fetchData side-effect; only runs Sunday >= 18:00 local. Existing IndexedDB persists across preview sessions in this environment (saw 4 notes on load).
rca of the issue: N/A — all fixes implemented correctly. Only one minor pre-existing pattern found: nested <button> inside KidPicker card. Recommend converting outer card <button> to <div role='button'> to eliminate the React HTML validation warning.
